assets.name: Car Concept
assets.author: Eric Chadwick / Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH
assets.changes: Original GLB preserved byte-for-byte. Runtime changes: scale to 95%, rotate 180° to the shared vehicle heading, animate existing wheel pivots, tint car-paint/rim/interior materials, optional contrasting secondary panels. No branded S2000 model is represented or claimed.
notices: Contains Khronos and 3D Commerce marks. © 2015 and © 2017 Khronos Group. Original logo notice is preserved in public/assets/cars/concept/KHRONOS-LOGO-LICENSE.txt; no endorsement is implied.
Upstream model began with a CC0 concept model by Unity Fan; the optimized model and textures distributed here are credited to Eric Chadwick / Darmstadt Graphics Group under CC BY 4.0.

assets.name: FOCUS R01 procedural roadster, scenery and surface textures
assets.author: FOCUS DRIVE project contributors
assets.license: Project-original; no third-party model license asserted
assets.changes: Original continuously lofted body with wheel arches, open cockpit, windscreen, bucket seats, rollover hoops, five-spoke rotating wheels, LED lighting, mirrors and diffuser. Generated at runtime; used when GLB is unavailable and as a selectable cosmetic. Road, sea, trees, mountains, bridge, city and textures are also generated locally.

assets.name: Engine loop · idle/low
assets.author: Provo rossi
assets.changes: Extracted a ~1.1s steady window measured at roughly 1154 rpm, highpassed at 55Hz, compressed, loudness-normalised, then looped over whole firing periods with a period-aligned crossfade. The runtime crossfades these layers and pitch-shifts them by engine speed. The source recording is not redistributed.
notices: CC BY 4.0 requires attribution. Recorded from a Ferrari 250 GTO at a public event; Ferrari and the vehicle owner do not endorse this project.
